abstract: OBJECTIVE: The purpose of this work was to describe the computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) findings in cases of dermoid cysts coexisting with surface epithelial tumors in the same ovary. METHODS: The pathologic reports of 141 dermoid cysts, 97 mucinous and 35 serous tumors were reviewed. The CT and/or MR images in the cases with a dermoid cyst and a surface epithelial tumor coexisting in the same ovary were analyzed. RESULTS: Eleven cases of mucinous tumors (6 benign, 3 low-grade, and 2 malignant) coexisted with dermoid cysts. Mucinous tumors were found in coexistence with 11.3% of dermoid cysts, and dermoid cysts were found in coexistence with 7.8% of mucinous tumors. In 10 cases, 3 radiologic patterns were observed: small fatty foci in the septa of the cystic tumor, an adjacent fat-containing component and a septated cystic component, and a dermoid cyst with no detectable mucinous tumor component. No histopathologically specific differences were observed between these groups. Small amounts of mucinous components were difficult to detect, but small fatty foci were easily detected. In 1 case, mucinous carcinoma formed a mass lesion in the wall of the dermoid cyst. CONCLUSIONS: The coexistence of these two neoplasms was not rare. If a dermoid cyst accompanies a multiseptated cyst and if the multiseptal cyst contains fatty foci, these two components may be associated. Recognizing the potential for the coexistence of these two neoplasms in the same ovary is essential for making a correct diagnosis.
abstract_ja: 目的：同一卵巣に類皮嚢腫と表層上皮性腫瘍が併存する症例のCTおよびMRI所見を記述すること。方法：類皮嚢腫141例、粘液性腫瘍97例、漿液性腫瘍35例の病理報告を見直した。類皮嚢腫と表層上皮性腫瘍が同一卵巣に併存する症例のCT・MRI画像を解析した。結果：粘液性腫瘍11例(良性6例、低悪性度3例、悪性2例)が類皮嚢腫と併存していた。粘液性腫瘍は類皮嚢腫の11.3%に併存し、類皮嚢腫は粘液性腫瘍の7.8%に併存していた。10例では3つの画像パターンが認められた。すなわち、嚢胞性腫瘍の隔壁内の小さな脂肪巣、脂肪を含む隣接成分と隔壁付き嚢胞成分、類皮嚢腫で粘液性腫瘍成分が検出されないもの、である。病理組織学的な特異的差異は、これらのグループ間で認められなかった。粘液成分が少量の場合は検出が困難であったが、小さな脂肪巣は容易に検出された。1例では、粘液性癌が類皮嚢腫の壁に腫瘤を形成していた。結論：これら2つの腫瘍の併存はまれではない。類皮嚢腫が多房性嚢胞を伴い、その多房性隔壁内に脂肪巣が存在する場合、この2つの成分が関連している可能性がある。同一卵巣におけるこの2つの腫瘍の併存の可能性を認識することは、正しい診断に不可欠である。
